categories.name: The automata laboratory
categories.blurb: A true cellular-automata workbench — six classical rule families plus the thirteen abiogenesis stages, with a rule editor, a pattern library and a measuring instrument.

categories.name: The origin-of-life labs
categories.blurb: Thirteen stages of abiogenesis — each a real experiment beside the electron micrograph it produces.

categories.name: Generative studios
categories.blurb: Open-ended engines you play with directly — grow, tune, and export.

categories.name: Life at every scale
categories.blurb: From a single individual’s origin to a whole drop of pond water.

categories.name: Galleries & film
categories.blurb: Rendered specimens and the studio reel — free to browse.

tools.name: The Automata Lab
tools.blurb: Life-like B/S and Generations rules, Larger than Life, Wolfram’s elementary rules, cyclic and Greenberg–Hastings excitable media, Wireworld and turmites — and the thirteen abiogenesis stages loaded from the lab itself. Write any rule, paint the lattice, load RLE patterns, and read population, activity, block entropy, Langton’s λ and an estimated Wolfram class live, beside an SEM micrograph.

tools.name: The Lab
tools.blurb: Thirteen abiogenesis stages, each a photoreal 3-D apparatus beside its live SEM micrograph, with per-stage parameter controls.

tools.name: The Guided Colony
tools.blurb: Everything in the lab, joined by a living-amoeba guide creature that narrates the stages and takes requests.

tools.name: Mark X
tools.blurb: A re-shell of the lab with a hero-art plate rail, a 13-node timeline scrubber and run provenance. Pro renders the current stage’s SEM micrograph in-page up to 4000×4000.

tools.name: The Instrument
tools.blurb: The lab with living guides and a live measurement layer — per-step observables, CSV export and shareable run URLs. Pro unlocks the Parameters rail.

tools.name: The Studio
tools.blurb: Flow fields, reaction–diffusion, Physarum, Lenia lifeforms, cymatics, crystal growth, a starling murmuration and morphing fractal worlds — all live. Open any tile for its control desk; Pro renders a real 4K video or still.

tools.name: Slime Studio
tools.blurb: Place nutrients and watch Physarum grow transport paths beside a live SEM-micrograph feed. Pro raises the colony and detail ceilings and exports a 4000² plate.

tools.name: Murmuration
tools.blurb: Thousands of birds at dusk from orientation-based social flocking on a real fixed-wing flight model — six regimes, a stooping peregrine, three camera modes and live order-parameter telemetry.

tools.name: Ontogeny
tools.tagline: Part II — the origin of an individual
tools.blurb: From sperm + egg to zygote and beyond — a real simulation of human development, and every condition that makes twins, triplets, quintuplets and more.

tools.name: Pond Water Analyzer
tools.tagline: A dark-field microscope of a virtual drop
tools.blurb: Six procedurally-grown organisms — bacterium to water flea — with true-to-life internal anatomy, under a continuous infinite-zoom dive from the whole drop to organ level.

tools.name: The Plates
tools.blurb: The plate for every stage — the look each live feed reaches toward.

tools.name: The Studio Reel
tools.blurb: A continuous reel of the generative studio — flow to fractal — rendered from the real engines.
